description.value:
Duration constant

Recovery from your own grafts or installs doesn't slow you down the way it slows everyone else.

Whether it's flesh knitting around new tissue or a housing seating into bone, your body's had the practice. Whenever a graft or install performed on you would leave you enfeebled 1 or clumsy 1, and drained 1, for a number of days equal to the augment's Grade, reduce that duration by 1 day (minimum 1 day).

cinderfall.incomplete: INSTALL-GRAFT-GAP. No rule element retroactively shortens the duration of a not-yet-applied, externally-narrated condition grant; the base penalty itself isn't modeled either.
